convert_gltf_to_embedded: run the gltf2embedded script to convert a glTF file with external references into a single embedded glTF file
embed_gltf_buffers: run the gltf2embedded script to base64-encode external buffer files into the glTF JSON as data URIs
embed_gltf_images: run the gltf2embedded script to base64-encode external PNG or basis image files into the glTF JSON as data URIs
review_gltf_embedding_logic: review the gltf2embedded script buffer and image URI embedding logic that checks for existing data URIs before encoding
summarize_gltf2embedded_script: summarize the gltf2embedded script which reads a glTF JSON, embeds external buffers and images as base64, and writes the output
